h: Settle the Scores, Then See More of Leicester
p: Bowling scoring has a habit of baffling people, so here's the quick version. A game has ten frames. A strike scores ten plus the pins from your next two balls, and a spare scores ten plus your next ball. That's why strings of strikes send scores rocketing, and why a perfect game totals 300. The screens do the maths, but at least you'll know why you've suddenly jumped ahead.

If you're new to the lanes, remember a few basics. Pick a ball you can control comfortably, aim at the arrows on the lane rather than the pins, and keep your follow-through straight. It's surprising how much better you get by game two.

There's loads more to see in Leicester. Leicester Cathedral is where Richard III was reburied after his remains were discovered, and it's just across from the visitor centre. Abbey Park is a lovely green space by the river, with gardens and the ruins of Leicester Abbey. And the city's Diwali celebrations along Belgrave Road's Golden Mile are famous, drawing big crowds every autumn for the lights and festivities.

For a group night, get the booking in early, especially at weekends and during university term. Arrive a little before your slot to sort drinks and food, and split teams sensibly so it doesn't turn into a whitewash. Then let the rivalry begin.
